tasks.title: PID loop period
tasks.statement: The gyro is read at **{g} Hz**, `pid_process_denom` = **{d}**. Find the PID loop period in microseconds.
tasks.solution: PID rate = gyro rate / `pid_process_denom`, period = 10⁶ · denom / gyro rate. 8 kHz and denom 1 — 125 µs; denom 2 — 4 kHz and 250 µs.

tasks.title: Converting failsafe_off_delay
tasks.statement: A backup from 4.5.3 has `set failsafe_off_delay = {v}`. Which `failsafe_landing_time` value gives the same landing time in 2025.12?
tasks.solution: `failsafe_off_delay` was stored in tenths of a second, `failsafe_landing_time` is in seconds: the old value is divided by 10. Carried over as the number “50” it would give 50 s instead of 5.
